role: TileEntitySpecialRenderer for TileEntityMobSpawner: renders the spawner's preview entity (MobSpawnerBaseLogic.func_98281_h) scaled 0.4375, tilted -30 degrees, spinning with the interpolated field_98287_c/field_98284_d yaw, through RenderManager.

members.name: func_147517_a
members.note: the modelview (the 0.4 lift, the spin times 10, the -30 degree tilt, the 0.4375 scale) and the mob through raster_mobs_draw with it (mob_render_input.outer). The display entity (func_98281_h, made on the first frame that draws the spawner) never ticks and setLocationAndAngles zeroes its yaw and pitch each frame, so RendererLivingEntity turns its body 0 and its head from prevRotationYawHead 0 to the constructor's rotationYawHead: that is the third of the EntityLivingBase constructor's three Math.random draws, which Det.PIN_SPAWNER takes from a stream reseeded at each construction with pinSeed(seed, 5, 0) on a tape whose start says spawnerPin (the RENDER role's shared stream is still drawn; an older tape's head is drawn unturned), and play computes it (det_spawner_display_yaw; the oracle's hyaw on idx-spawnerhead-s1 is 0x3f5a9587, the same float). The spin is the client tile entity's own: made by the S35 that follows the block into the client world, from the Delay that packet carried (the server's desc_delay, the spawnDelay before the tick's update), then MobSpawnerBaseLogic's client half each tick in range (play's tileents_tick); play_check compares rot, prev and delay per row on out/java/snapshots/idx-spawner-s1. Recordings made before the pin keep their rotations from the recording (test_rendertick's te_spawner, te_dungeon).

notes: te_spawner: eight spawners (zombie, skeleton, spider, cave spider, silverfish, blaze, pig, creeper) over five frames; te_dungeon: the seed-42 dungeon's spider. Recordings take a warm-up frame first so the entities exist. The spin steps natively (raster_tileents_spawner_tick, test_rendertick section 6: 37 turns, bit for bit). lane/idxclient: idx-spawnerhead-s1 (a pig spawner a dev setblock placed 2.5 blocks ahead, shots at 24 to 70) matches the pig bit for bit at every shot; the 29 to 358 px left are the far edge of the stone floor, a terrain seam; with the head yaw 0 the tick-30 shot measures 92 px instead of 49, and the spin started from the server's delay after its update (the old start) 391.
